negative_rules.name: guard_expression.no_step_root
negative_rules.reason: guards run before effectful step execution and therefore cannot depend on registered step results
negative_rules.rule: Registered step references are not allowed in guard expressions

negative_rules.name: guard_expression.no_adapter_write_path
negative_rules.reason: guard expressions may use read-only local-expression constructs but must remain pure and pre-execution-safe
negative_rules.rule: Representation-adapter write paths such as '->...' are not allowed in guard expressions

negative_rules.name: guard_expression.boolean_result_required
negative_rules.reason: guard success and failure are defined by boolean policy outcomes rather than arbitrary value production
negative_rules.rule: Guard expressions must evaluate to a boolean result

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.exactly_one_form
negative_rules.reason: step forms are mutually exclusive in the workflow contract
negative_rules.rule: A workflow step must define exactly one of uses, value, state_set, or state_delete

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.with_requires_uses
negative_rules.reason: runtime value inputs belong to operation-call step form only
negative_rules.rule: The with field is allowed only together with uses

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.launcher_requires_uses
negative_rules.reason: launcher selection wraps operation-call execution surfaces rather than builtin value or state steps
negative_rules.rule: The launcher field is allowed only together with uses

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.register_requires_uses
negative_rules.reason: the MVP publishes registered step results only for operation-call steps, reusable run invocations, and pure value steps
negative_rules.rule: The register field is allowed only together with uses, run, or value

negative_rules.name: workflow_step.if_conflicts_with_register
negative_rules.reason: the MVP avoids publishing synthetic registered step results for skipped conditional steps
negative_rules.rule: The if and register fields cannot be used together in the MVP

negative_rules.name: embedded_value_expression.step_refs_must_be_backward
negative_rules.reason: step-result reads are order-sensitive execution-local data flow rather than random access workflow state
negative_rules.rule: Registered step references may target only earlier steps in the same workflow

negative_rules.name: state_set.single_target_entry
negative_rules.reason: each state-set step writes one resolved state target at a time
negative_rules.rule: state_set must contain exactly one target entry

negative_rules.name: workflow_fragment.no_state_surface
negative_rules.reason: runtime state remains a top-level workflow handoff surface rather than reusable fragment-local memory
negative_rules.rule: Included fragments must not read, declare, or mutate runtime state

negative_rules.name: workflow_state_role.write_after_last_read
negative_rules.reason: persistent runtime state should capture final cross-run handoff rather than per-run scratch flow
negative_rules.rule: Logical state role writes and deletes are allowed only after the final read of that same role

negative_rules.name: format_value.args_must_be_list
negative_rules.reason: format object arguments are evaluated positionally
negative_rules.rule: format-object args must be a list when provided
